scope: Eight new prompt formulations on four source behaviors; evaluator only, not agent input. No claim that subsystem concepts were unseen in all earlier investigations.

corpus.selection: Same 97 product source files as P4; no docs, tests, reports or evaluator rubrics.

unchanged: 7/8 complete, >=3 per language, no baseline task/clause regressions or unsupported claims; writer4/4 per language; +1 complete task OR >=20% fewer bytes on shared complete tasks. All original timing, tool, round and 64 KiB limits retained.
controls: P4 prompts and receipts are regression controls, never fresh holdout. Freeze candidate/runtime hashes before first run. No quality retry or question editing after observation.

topics.english: Before loading a new snapshot, how does the resident cache reserve memory, choose an eviction victim, and handle generations still held by active requests?
topics.russian: Как резидентный кэш перед загрузкой нового снимка резервирует память, выбирает жертву вытеснения и учитывает поколения, которые еще используются запросами?
clauses: reserves full generation cap before I/O, not just eventual size
only cache-exclusive use_count==1 owners can be evicted; least recently used eligible victim
active owners remain counted; no eligible victim causes snapshot-cache-busy rather than excess allocation

topics.english: When loading a snapshot fails or returns the wrong identity, how are the resident cache reservation and waiting requests released, and what bound applies while another load is in progress?
topics.russian: Если загрузка снимка завершается ошибкой или возвращает другую идентичность, как кэш освобождает резерв и ожидающие запросы, и сколько можно ждать уже выполняющуюся загрузку?
clauses: 500ms wait deadline while a loader is active; busy refusal on timeout
reject null/oversized payload or different snapshot identity before insertion
destroy failed payload before clearing loading reservation; lock and notify waiters; rethrow failure

topics.english: Can an optional project in session bootstrap avoid authorization, or can an earlier project load evidence before all members have been authorized? Explain the ordering implemented in source.
topics.russian: Может ли необязательный проект в bootstrap сессии избежать авторизации, или первый проект начать загрузку свидетельств до проверки всех участников? Объясни порядок по исходникам.
clauses: at least one required member; stable required-first partition
all members including optional authorized before any retrieval
authorization failure aborts before any member evidence retrieval

topics.english: How does session bootstrap distinguish available context from cached health, and what happens when the health observation belongs to a different generation than the retrieved context?
topics.russian: Как bootstrap сессии различает доступность контекста и сохраненную оценку здоровья, и что происходит, если здоровье относится к другому поколению, чем полученный контекст?
clauses: health agreement compares project route workspace host snapshot preparation revision and publication identity
healthy and selection_aligned plus matching generation are required; mismatch recorded as bootstrap-selection-changed
only required members determine combined context_ready and health_ready; independent observations are not atomic or checkpoint restoration
